title: Anisotropic 2D FUP and quantum open baker's map
summary: We prove an essential spectral gap for 2D anisotropic quantum open baker's map. This extends the 1D results of Dyatlov--Jin 2017 and the isotropic 2D results of Cohen 2025a. The key ingredient is the anisotropic discrete fractal uncertainty principle (FUP) associated with a 2D anisotropic fractal set called the Bedford--McMullen carpet. We also study the relation between our anisotropic discrete FUP and its continuous counterpart in the spirit of Dyatlov--Jin 2018 and Cohen 2025a.
